lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: In the end, you didn’t submit. Not delayed, not contested—just absent. The system only counts what crosses the desk.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A deadline is a gate, not a conversation. Without a submission, nothing is reviewed, nothing is argued, nothing is saved.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The list went up. Your name wasn’t missing because it failed—it was missing because it never arrived.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: There is no footnote for almost. The work you meant to hand in doesn’t enter the story. It stays outside the door, invisible.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: What follows is simple: this attempt ends here. If there’s a next one, it starts from zero and begins earlier.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: No one took it from you. No disaster rewrote the rules. It was absence—quiet and complete.
